GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped Well Wide out. Went Forward Crossed Slight Lead early . then 3 Wide 2nd within 1 length @ 1000m. Hard Ridden 500m, giving Ground now. dropped right out Straight # weak once beat
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Near the 200m, laid in and had to be corrected.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped Ok sat handy 2 Lengths off, under pressure turn, Straightened Up 3l off, found little plodded home # weak run home
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Began awkwardly and bumped with another runner.
Passing the 200m, shifted out across the heels of another runner, which shifted in marginally.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped evenly. Not pushed early & raced well back Two Wide (8L from lead). Back to rear Two Wide midrace & pushed to quicken 3 Wide @ 500m. Chasing Four Wide (8L from lead) on home turn. Only held ground in straight. winkers off first time. # Always struggling.
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Was bumped on jumping by another runner.

When questioned rdr reported that her mount did not appreciate today’s very soft dirt surface. She added that her mount was under pressure from the 800m, failed to respond to her riding and was disappointing in the manner in which it closed off its race. A post-race veterinary examination revealed no abnormalities. Trainer was advised that a warning would be placed on the record on the for being uncompetitive.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped okay & Settled Down last trailing 8 Lengths Two Wide , Drifted Back to 10 Lengths Two Wide turning, Made Ground one of the fence in Straight # got too far back

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Jockey reported that, although his mount established a margin on the field, it travelled only fairly in the lead and was not comfortable on the tight, undulating track. He said that, as another runner improved to head his mount near the 600m, the gelding did not respond to his riding and commenced to weaken before being eased down over the concluding stages when beaten. He said that, in his opinion, the gelding did not appreciate the heavy track conditions and was unsuited by the heavy weight impost. Post race vet revealed slow recovery rate. Warning recorded.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped Ok Settled Down 6th 4 lengths. well back turn under pressure 6 lengths. weakened # poor
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Began awkwardly. Rider explained that his mount raced keenly in the early and middle stages and was under pressure to prior to the 800m and was disappointing in the manner in which it finished off. Trainer reported pulled up well and may not have been suited by tight turning and undulating track. Post-race vet no abnormalities.

Jumped Well , Settled Down Two Wide 4th, 4 Lengths @ 1450m. fanned wider into Straight all Clear . couldn't quicken at all, Just Held Ground # couldn't quicken
